blurb: Past Tense offers a variety of yoga classes including Vinyasa Flow, Restorative, Prenatal, Kids Yoga, and specialty classes like Yoga for Runners. Classes range from beginner to advanced levels and include options for parents with babies and toddlers. Memberships provide access to in-studio, livestream, and on-demand classes.
extraNote: All sales are final; memberships are non-transferable and do not pause or pro-rate · Memberships auto-renew monthly after 3-month commitment until canceled · Cancel membership via account dashboard; cancellation processed within one business day · At the studio at 3131 Mt. Pleasant St.
